en:
All right, I better start training! Akiyama-han, ya gotta
come try my okonomiyaki again sometime, okay?

(I don't quite get how, but it seems I really lit a fire
under the guy.)

(Well, he can cook, so if he can get more people to stop by
and try his food, I'm sure he'll be set.)
Hey, you, fella. Know anything about baseball?
Oh, you mean me? Well, I guess you could say I do.
Oh! Then today's my lucky day! My name's Pedro, by the way. Nice to meet ya!
Same. I'm Shinada.
Ah, Shinaaada. Has a nice ring to it. Anyway, where I come from, we have no baseball, so we have no batting either.
Everybody plays soccer instead. This trip to Japan is actually the first time I've stepped up to bat! It's kinda fun!
But no matter how much I tried, I could never make the ball go sailing. It's hard to hit it right.
Okay, so what's your angle? You want me to show you how to bat?
Exactamundo! Even if it's only for a little bit!
Oh, all right. But only for a little bit, okay?
Sure! You're awesome, Shinaaada!
Uh-huh. So, where do I start? I may as well just show you. I'll demonstrate, so watch carefully.
You got it! I'll use my laser focus!
I'd like to show you, but I'm kinda busy right now.
Ahh, so Shinaaada's a busy man. Tell ya what! I'll keep hanging out here, so that way you can teach me whenever you have time! Sound like a plan?
Sure. Maybe practice your swing till then.
Shinaaada, my friend! Will you show me how to bat? Just for a little bit?
You bet! Promise I won't screw it up this time.
No sweat, just do your thing! You got this!
Shoot. I totally crapped out there.
What happened, Shinaaada? Is that really the best you got?
No, no. I'm just out of sync today. Gimme a few moments and I'll be right back at it!
Got it! Then I'll be waiting right here!
There! That's how it's done.
Shinaaada! That was crazy! You slaughtered that poor ball!
How do you even do that? What's the secret?
Secret? Mm, how should I put it?
Okay, so, the way you grip the bat and swing, that's honestly up to whatever you like, really. I guess you can say there are three major things you have to do.
One, keep your eyes on the ball. Two, perfect your impact timing. And three, try to hit the ball with your bat's sweet spot.
The sweet spot, eh? Where is it?
Oh, that's... kind of tricky to answer, come to think of it.
Think of it this way. There's a line right down the middle of the bat. If you can hit a pitch on that line, that would be the sweet spot.
Okay, got it. The sweet spot is the center of the bat.
That sounds about right. After this, you should go up against the machines to get a better feel for it.
Keep eyes on the ball. Get the right timing. Hit with the sweet spot. Shinaaada, I think I got it!
Yeah, it sure sounds like it. If you can do those three things, you'll be hammering home runs in no time.
Sweet, I'll try that out right now! Thanks, brotha!
Just sit back and watch your protégé at work!
(It all comes down to practice. I should look in on him sometime.)
You got 1,200 experience points.
Care to play? It'll only cost you 100,000 yen.
Who in their right mind would pay that much for something they know nothing about!?
No, wait!
Darn, lost another one. We'll never be able to run our test like this, doctor.
Epoch-making inventions are seldom understood by lesser minds. Ah! You, there!
Are you talking to me?
Would you like to play a⑬Wait a second. I know you. You're, um...
Er... Who are you again? I'm afraid I've become rather forgetful in my old age.
Sorry, but I don't know you.
Hmm... Is that so? Well, my mistake.
It's just that you bear a striking resemblance to a man who aided me in the past.
Fascinating. Well, I have to go.
No, please! Wait!
What do you want now?
We're looking for someone to playtest our newly developed game system. Please, won't you consider giving it a try?
Aw, please, don't be like that! This is Doctor Minamida, and I'm his assistant.
This is the culmination of years of work: the newest version of my Inner Fighter arcade machine!
Inner Fighter?
It's my brand new game machine, my boy! It uses special electromagnetic waves to let you experience realistic fights within your very mind!
I present to you the latest Inner Fighter! I call it Inner Fighter 8: Road Battle, or IF8 for short!
Is it invisible or something?
No, look. It's right here!
IF8 uses this microtransceiver to communicate in realtime with the main unit back at my lab.
And that means you can play the game from anywhere in the world.
Right... Should I be impressed?
Yes! Don't you know what that means!? IF8 is my epoch-making advance in arcade machine technology!
However, it's not quite finished yet. We're currently testing the microtransceiver's remote communication functionality.
And that's why we're looking for someone to play. It's the only way we'll get the test data we need, but we haven't had much luck.
We'd love for you to give it a try. What do you say?
Like I said, I'm busy now.
Then how about when you do have some time? Please! We need your help!
Any time is fine. We'll be here whenever you're prepared.
Oh, marvelous! You came back! Are you ready to play IF8?
So good to see you again. Would you like to play IF8?
All right, I'll explain to you how to play.
IF8 allows you to play what I like to call "road battles" in which you stroll through a town fighting enemies until you reach their boss.
Beat the boss, and you earn an ability boost.
I only have data for one town right now, but we're busy collecting data for others.
All we need is a little more, and you'll be able to play in other towns. You'll have to be patient until then.
Finally, it'll be 10,000 yen to play. And that's with a special discount just for you!
Well, care to play?
Wonderful. Now select the stage you'd like to play.
Nagasugai? All right, that will be 10,000 yen.
Let the road battle commence!
Kamurocho? All right, that will be 10,000 yen.
It appears you're a little low on funds. Running the machine is expensive, so I'm afraid I'll have to ask you to come back when you can pay.
Why thank you! We can use all the help we can get.
Our total investments have reached %s. How much would you like to invest?
This should be enough to upgrade IF8 to the latest version I've been working on.
Just one moment, please.
And... done! IF8 is now upgraded to version 1.1!
The Kamurocho stage is now playable thanks to the upgrade.
I hope you'll try it sometime. Well, until we meet again.
Your cooperation is greatly appreciated. Total investments now stand at %s.
Once we reach 100,000 yen, I'll be able to add a new stage for you to play.
I trust you'll make the necessary investment.
And... done! IF8 is now upgraded to version 1.2!
In version 1.2, you can earn Soul Orbs by completing a stage.
But! You must complete the same stage a number of times. Give it a try!
Oh, and this is the final upgrade, so there's no need for any more investments. Thank you for all your help.
With 200,000 yen, I could add new features.
Hm, you're broke? Well, I'm far too busy to be dealing with looky-loos. Good day.
This is the final version, so there will be no more updates.
Oh, very well then. I'll be here in case you feel like playing later.
Come again soon. I'll be waiting for you.
Where'd your assistant go?
I sent him off to do some work in another town. I'm hoping he'll be able to get the data I need.
You'll be able play IF8 there too if you run into him. It's an opportunity you won't want to miss.
You don't want to invest? Well, I'm far too busy to be dealing with looky-loos. Good day.
Oh, what a shame. It seems you've been defeated.
Well, try again when you're ready.
I see you've won. Well, congratulations.
You seem to have enhanced an ability. This should give us some excellent data.
<Color:9>Heat Gauge capacity increased.<Color:Default>
Come again soon. I'll be waiting for your return.
You've earned a Soul Orb thanks to the new version I built.
Your abilities can't be enhanced any further. Here's a prize for your trouble instead.
This version of IF8 can't raise your abilities any further. Here's a prize for your trouble instead.
<Color:9>The maximum value of the Heat Gauge increased.<Color:Default>
Pardon me, miss. May I ask you a question?
Would you by any chance consider yourself a gamer?
A gamer?
You know, a gamer⑬a person who likes video games?
Yes, I suppose I do like video games.

I knew it! In that case, could you spare a moment of your
time? It's right this way!
What do you want me to do?

Oh, my apologies, I should have been more clear. It's
nothing weird, I can assure you. If you could just spare a
minute, you'll be back in no time!
No, I'm afraid I don't really play video games all that much.

Oh, what a shame. In that case, never mind. I'm sorry to
have bothered you.

Pardon me, but you are a gamer after all, aren't you? I just
have this feeling.

Doctor! I've brought a girl gamer! I'm sorry it took so
long!
Ah, at long last! Now we can finally begin the experiment!
Um, experiment? What kind of experiment?
Heheheh. I am Doctor Minamida. And this device is the new version of my fighting simulator, "Inner Fighter 8: Road Battle"!
We call it "IF8" for short.

IF8 is a revolutionary gaming device of my own invention. It
utilizes special electromagnetic waves to allow the player
to play inside their own head.
We'd like you to test it out.
I'm afraid I still don't really understand.

Heheh. I'm not surprised, my dear! IF8 is still in
development, you see.

Though I am indeed its creator, there's still a lot about it
I don't quite understand myself! Thus, we need to test it.

And this particular IF8 is a female version. I've modified
it to be specially suited to female gamers like you.

My assistant here was so proud of this modification that I
rushed to Osaka to see it, but apparently, it's only suited
to female players.
And here you are at last!
So I would be the very first one to use it?

Precisely! But there's absolutely nothing to be afraid of,
my dear. I'm sure you will enjoy it immensely.

In this game, you'll become a magical heroine and combat
fearsome enemies deep within your mind. Haven't you always
dreamed of doing something like that?
I suppose when I was younger...

Well, this game makes that dream a reality! But instead of
trying to explain, perhaps I should just let you try it for
yourself. Are you ready?

Oh, just a minute, doctor! Before she tests it, she'll need
to sign that agreement we talked about.
Agreement?

We must maintain absolute secrecy around the IF8 project
while it's being developed. We therefore need you to sign
a non-disclosure agreement.
A non-disclosure agreement? Well, um, I don't know about signing something so suddenly like that...

Your cooperation would be most appreciated! It isn't as easy
to acquire a female game tester as one might think. Won't
you please consider helping us?

The chance to become the magical heroine of your dreams is
just a sign away!
All right. Where do I sign?
Oh, thank you!

Wonderful, my dear! My assistant here will prepare the
document for you. Meanwhile, I'll be getting the device
ready.
Now, before you begin, allow me to explain the particulars.

IF8 has players move along a city street and vanquish
enemies using their magical powers. A powerful boss awaits
at the end.

Defeat this boss, and you'll receive a boost to your
abilities. Not those of the player character, but your own!
You mean my own, personal abilities will increase if I win the game?

Precisely! But I'm afraid we're still in the process of
gathering data, so only one city is available for play at
the moment.

You'll be able to play other cities once we've collected
enough data, but unfortunately, you'll have to wait a while
for that.

As we've previously mentioned, IF8 is still under
development. We'll need quite a bit more funding if we wish to complete it.

Speaking of which, do you think you would be willing to
contribute to the funding of this project?
Hm? You want me to contribute money?

There would be something in it for you as well. Once the
device is finished, we'll be able to provide you with a wide
variety of feedback.

We hope you'll give it some thought. Our project is in
desperate need of funding.

Ordinarily, one play would cost 10,000 yen, but, for this
first time only, we'll let you test it free of charge.
